versions.changelog:
identity-emergence-field v1.0.0

- Initial release of the identity-emergence-field skill.
- Enables treating tasks as emergent fields, recognizing emergent characteristics and complexity, and activating relevant identity fields to form a temporary consensus network.
- Consensus network converges automatically to output; field interaction details are hidden by default but can be revealed on user request.
- Implements a 5-step execution framework and covers 7 domains with 37 types of task methodologies.
- Includes rules for fact discipline and downgrade modes (read-only and permission model).
